component.name: MoneyUnderBed DeskPet
床下有罐钱桌宠
component.summary: 《床下有罐钱》非官方非商业桌宠

description.p: Puts the heroine of MoneyUnderBed on your desktop. She walks around, rests and says a few lines on her own, and you can click, drag and feed her.
把《床下有罐钱》的女主放到桌面上：她会自己走动、休息、说几句话，也可以被点击、拖动和投喂。

ul.li: 四方向移动与像素动画
Click, drag and ice cream feeding
点击、拖动和冰淇淋投喂互动
Short lines and conversations true to the original character (in Chinese)
符合原作人设的短句和连续对话
Adjustable activity, dialogue, animation, display scale and window behavior
可调整活动、对话、动画、显示倍率与窗口行为

description.p: This is an unofficial, non-commercial fan project. It is not affiliated with, published by, or endorsed by the developers of MoneyUnderBed. The character assets are not covered by the GPL: no commercial use, no R18 content and no use for AI training.
本程序是非官方、非商业的二次创作项目，与《床下有罐钱》的开发者没有隶属关系，也不由其发布或背书。 角色素材不属于 GPL：不可商用、禁止 R18、禁止用于 AI 训练。
